svg.title: Four workplaces at twenty past eleven
svg.desc: Four workplaces drawn side by side at the same moment - a cafe kitchen, a school office, a hospital corridor and a small factory - each with somebody doing something outside their job title.

g.text: Four workplaces at twenty past eleven
Fourteen things to find. In every one of them, somebody is doing something that is not in their job title.
the kitchen - forty coffees by eleven
the office - and nobody at the desk
the corridor - a shift that started at seven
the floor - one machine, not working
Dona Filipa - a cleaner, answering the phone
Ana - at a desk she is not sitting at
a nurse - five hours into a twelve-hour shift
the machine that is not working
